title: Reset Your HylooSec Password
description: Verify your identity using your account details and create a new password.

blocks.text: The Forgot Password page allows you to reset your HylooSec account password after verifying your identity using the details provided during account creation.

blocks.title: Before You Begin
blocks.text: Keep your User ID, selected date of birth, security question and security answer ready.

fields.name: User ID
fields.description: Enter the User ID generated when your HylooSec account was created.
fields.important: Enter the correct User ID associated with your account.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Enter the same date of birth that you selected during account creation.
fields.important: The entered date must match the date stored with your account.

fields.name: Security Question
fields.description: Select the same security question that you selected during registration.

fields.name: Security Answer
fields.description: Enter the same answer that you provided for your security question during account creation.
fields.important: Use the same spelling and format as the original answer.

items.title: Enter Your User ID
items.description: Enter the User ID associated with your HylooSec account.

items.title: Enter Your Date of Birth
items.description: Provide the same date selected while creating your account.

items.title: Select the Security Question
items.description: Choose the security question linked to your account.

items.title: Enter the Security Answer
items.description: Provide the correct answer to the selected security question.

items.title: Verify Details
items.description: Click the Verify Details button to confirm your identity.

blocks.text: After your account details are successfully verified, a new password form will appear.

fields.name: New Password
fields.description: Enter a new and strong password for your HylooSec account.

fields.name: Confirm Password
fields.description: Enter the same new password again to confirm it.
fields.important: The New Password and Confirm Password fields must match.

items.title: Enter a New Password
items.description: Create a strong password that you have not shared with anyone.

items.title: Confirm the New Password
items.description: Enter the same password again in the Confirm Password field.

items.title: Update Password
items.description: Submit the form to replace your old password with the new password.

blocks.text: After the password is successfully updated, HylooSec displays a success page confirming that your password has been changed.

items: Your old password will no longer work.
Use your existing User ID with the new password on the login page.
No account-details PDF or encrypted key file is downloaded during password reset.
Your existing account and chat security method remain unchanged.

blocks.title: Next Step
blocks.text: Return to the Login page and sign in using your User ID and updated password.
You can click the Back to Login button at any time to leave the Forgot Password page and return to the HylooSec login screen.

items.solution: Check the User ID provided on your account success page or saved account document.

items.problem: Date of birth does not match
items.solution: Enter the same date that you selected during account creation.
Select the exact security question linked to your account.
Enter the answer using the same spelling and format used during registration.
Enter the same password in both the New Password and Confirm Password fields.
Check your internet connection and verify that all account details are entered correctly.

items: Create a strong and unique password.
Do not reuse your previous password.
Do not share your new password with anyone.
Avoid using easily guessed information in your password.
Always reset your password through the official HylooSec website.

popup.title: Forgot Password Help
content: Enter your User ID and date of birth.
Create and confirm your new password.
After the password is updated, return to Login.
No PDF or key file is downloaded during password reset.
